rows.value: €55 to €65 per tonne of CO2 in 2026 (price corridor); €55 fixed in 2025. Paid by fuel suppliers (passed on in fuel prices). Brennstoffemissionshandelsgesetz § 10.

rows.section: List of taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax
rows.source_title: Senatsverwaltung für Finanzen Berlin: FAQ Übernachtungsteuer (City Tax)
rows.label: Tourist and overnight taxes (Übernachtungsteuer, Kurtaxe) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by municipalities; Berlin 7.5% of the net room price. Paid by overnight guests (collected by hosts). Land municipal tax laws and municipal statutes (Berlin: Übernachtungsteuergesetz).

rows.section: List of taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F4; detailed table: air-passenger-tax
rows.label: Air passenger tax (Luftverkehrsteuer) [national]
rows.value: €13.03, €33.01 or €59.43 per departing passenger by distance band from 1 July 2026 (€15.53, €39.34 or €70.83 before). Paid by airlines (passed on in fares). Luftverkehrsteuergesetz § 11.

rows.section: List of taxes, levies and charges: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.label: Customs duty, import VAT and traveller allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: €3 duty per item on consignments up to €150 from 1 July 2026; import VAT 19% or 7%; traveller allowance €430 (air and sea) or €300; cash of €10,000 or more disclosed on request. Paid by importers and travellers. EU customs law (Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382); Zollverwaltungsgesetz § 12a.

rows.note: Checklist item H2; detailed table: tv-licence
rows.source_title: Bundesverfassungsgericht, Pressemitteilung Nr. 69/2021 zum Beschluss vom 20. Juli 2021 (1 BvR 2756/20 u. a.)
rows.label: Broadcasting contribution (broadcasting licence fee) (Rundfunkbeitrag) [national]
rows.value: €18.36 per dwelling per month. Paid by occupants of dwellings and businesses. Rundfunkbeitragsstaatsvertrag; Federal Constitutional Court order of 20 July 2021.
